transport.notes: No documented external-client ordinary-ChatGPT conversation transport consuming normal ChatGPT plan usage has been identified.

evidence: Current Apps SDK/MCP documentation describes apps/tools running inside ChatGPT, not Pi submitting ordinary ChatGPT turns through an external-client transport.
ADR-0016A rejects browser automation, DOM extraction, private endpoints, and ChatGPT cookie/session-token reuse.
No qualifying external ChatGPT thread/conversation identity and retry/idempotency contract is documented because no qualifying transport has been identified.
ChatGPT and API billing remain separate; Codex plan access does not prove ordinary ChatGPT pool semantics for a third-party client.
Provider-neutral Pi-mediated tool continuation is validated, but cannot be exercised against ordinary ChatGPT until a qualifying transport exists.
Aiopago durable delivery/reconciliation semantics are validated provider-neutrally, but transport-specific ambiguous-delivery behavior cannot be qualified without a real supported transport.
